items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed. Risk severity is high for public exposure and security-sensitive releases, and medium for bounded reversible growth. Fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release/deployment controls, dependency provenance, complete TLS posture, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No incident or exploitation is evidenced. No certificate is reported expiring within 30 days, but that does not establish complete TLS safety. Compliance is technical baseline evidence only: 35 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown. Exact decision: block public exposure and security-sensitive releases; permit only ordinary bounded reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, and data-handling boundaries.

Continue the existing bounded read-only fleet security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record dated, redacted evidence and explicit unknowns for access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, requeue unchanged work, or conduct external outreach.
